sources.name: ESPN FPI
sources.description: ESPN Football Power Index simulation forecasts, not betting odds. Values are percent probabilities; complete division groups normalized to 100%. Provider update time may precede capture.

sources.name: DraftKings
sources.description: DraftKings sportsbook American futures odds syndicated by ESPN, independent of FPI. Complete Super Bowl, conference and division markets are proportionally de-vigged to 100%; incomplete markets retain raw implied probabilities. No playoff or win-total estimates are invented.

sources.name: Bovada
sources.description: Bovada sportsbook American futures and season props. Complete Super Bowl, conference and division markets are de-vigged to 100%. Playoff chances use two-way Yes/No implied probabilities; win totals reflect regular-season over/under lines.

sources.name: Polymarket
sources.description: Polymarket decentralized prediction market contracts. Real-time probabilities derived from on-chain trading prices on Polygon for championship, conference, division, and individual player awards.

snapshots.label: September Preseason

espn-fpi.note: ESPN reports season 2026. Probabilities are supplied in percent, not fractions. Conference = make Super Bowl (probmaketitlegame), not make conference championship. Complete nonzero division groups normalized to exactly 100%. Provider lastUpdated 2026-08-31T14:44:00.000Z; captured 2026-09-08T16:56:42.327Z. Delayed data warning: provider update is 8 days older than capture. Season 2026 kickoff from ESPN's first regular-season event; week boundaries from ESPN calendar where available.

bovada.note: Bovada sportsbook futures and season props for season 2026. Championship, conference, and division markets de-vigged to 100%. leaders.note: 2026 regular-season leaders not started: HTTP 404 from sports.core.api.espn.com/v2/sports/football/leagues/nfl/seasons/2026/types/2/leaders. Preseason/postseason statistics and previous-season totals are never substituted.

draftkings.note: Retrospectively attached to the September 8 preseason baseline from pre-opener publications, not captured by the app at that time. DraftKings Network supplies the preseason column for MVP, OPOY, DPOY, OROY, DROY and CPOY. CBS Sports supplies selected COY and Protector prices and independently corroborates Drake Maye MVP +1000. Sources are publisher-dated evidence, not independently archived closing prices. Identity alignment uses verified season-specific ESPN records; no historical roster claim is made. These September 8 observations are not September 1 or earlier monthly captures.
